findings.reader: A well-bounded dated news article that answers legal status first, explains both proposed braking mechanisms with their triggers and coverage, keeps attribution and uncertainty intact, and ends with a specific transferable four-question tool. No failure families present; explain-back and a novel state-licensing transfer scenario both succeed on the article's own mechanisms.
findings.facts: All fifteen claims verify against their assigned source excerpts with attribution and legal-status limits intact. One claim (superintelligence-definition) is qualified: 'defeat important forms of human control' compresses the source's 'overthrow human governments' clause, but the sponsor attribution and shutdown-command example are preserved. Dates, sequencing and the proposals-versus-law distinction are accurate throughout.
